title: Pound to New Zealand Dollar Week Ahead Exchange Rate Outlook: Further Upside
text: Looking ahead, the primary catalyst of movement for the Pound New Zealand Dollar exchange rate looking ahead to this week will likely be data releases from the UK and New Zealand. Regarding the Pound, the UK is set to release its latest employment data on Tuesday and inflation figures on Wednesday.

title: GBP/NZD Exchange Rate News: Sterling Rangebound amid UK CPI and Risk-Off Mood
text: Looking ahead, New Zealand's latest inflation figures are also due out, with the quarterly inflation rate set to be published overnight on Wednesday. City economists expect to see an uptick in New Zealand inflation in the first quarter of 2025, from 2.2% to 2.3%.
